title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Ten named campus destinations for studying, making, gathering, moving, reflecting, and taking part in College life.

cards.title: The Power Plant Interim Library
cards.subtitle: Temporary library location during Saint Albert Hall modernization
cards.notes: Start here for the service desk, technology checkout, course reserves, browsing collection, and study rooms while the main library is closed.
cards.short_summary: A practical academic stop with library services and study rooms in the Power Plant.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s states that interim library services in the Power Plant include a service desk, technology checkout, course reserves, study rooms, and a browsing collection.
cards.source_title: A New Chapter for Our Library
cards.access_notes: Saint Albert Hall is closed for modernization; library services are temporarily in the Power Plant. Check the library site for service details.

cards.title: The Student Media Center in Sichel Hall
cards.subtitle: Study lounge and hybrid screening/editing lab
cards.notes: Bring a project or a classmate and use the lounge’s screening and editing setup; the College identifies the space as available to all students.
cards.short_summary: A named Sichel Hall lounge for studying, screening, and editing work.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s describes the Student Media Center in Sichel Hall as a study lounge and hybrid screening/editing lab available to all students.
cards.access_notes: The College says the space is available to all students; confirm any equipment or room-use procedures before planning a session.

cards.title: The Intercultural Center at Delphine Lounge
cards.subtitle: Between the bookstore and Café Louis on Ferroggiaro Quad
cards.notes: Check the IC calendar or drop into its programs and services to connect around identity, cultural learning, student leadership, and social justice.
cards.short_summary: A Delphine Lounge-based center for co-curricular programs and inclusive community building.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says the Intercultural Center is located in Delphine Lounge and provides programs and services that foster cultural competence, social justice, and belonging.
cards.access_notes: Located along Ferroggiaro Quad between the bookstore and Café Louis; consult the IC calendar for scheduled programs.

cards.title: The Alioto Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Campus recreation, fitness, courts, pool, and climbing wall
cards.notes: Complete the required waiver, then choose a workout, court activity, swim, climbing session, or fitness class that fits your day.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation facility built for exercise, socializing, and learning new activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s says currently enrolled students have access to the Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center, which includes fitness equipment, courts, pool, climbing wall, and class rooms.
cards.source_title: About the Facility | Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center
cards.access_notes: Currently enrolled SMC students have access; incoming students must complete the facility waiver. Check the facility calendar and current hours.

cards.title: Café Louis and Ferroggiaro Quad
cards.subtitle: Coffee shop with seating inside and outdoors by the quad
cards.notes: Use the café as a meet-up point, then take food or a drink to the indoor seating or the outdoor tables beside Ferroggiaro Quad.
cards.short_summary: A campus coffee shop whose seating extends to the adjacent quad.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s identifies Café Louis as a coffee shop and states that meals may be enjoyed inside the café or outdoors in Ferroggiaro Quad.
cards.access_notes: Food and drinks are sold; check the College dining page for current operating hours and offerings.

cards.title: Oliver Hall
cards.subtitle: Main student dining hall
cards.notes: Meet over a meal and use the published dining information to plan around the hall’s food stations and dietary-support options.
cards.short_summary: The College’s main student dining hall, with a range of food options.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s identifies Oliver Hall as the main dining hall available to students and notes its variety of food options and Clean Plates station.
cards.access_notes: Dining requires a meal plan, points, or another form of payment as applicable. Verify current hours and service details before going.

cards.title: The Legacy Garden
cards.subtitle: Half-acre campus garden beside Claeys South
cards.notes: Join posted volunteer hours or workshops, or take a slow loop through the garden; email Sustainability for ways to participate.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor educational garden with volunteer work, workshops, and community growing.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s describes the Legacy Garden as a half-acre living laboratory and outdoor educational space where students contribute service hours; everyone is welcome to work in and enjoy it.
cards.access_notes: The garden is entered through the South Claeys Residential Hall parking lot. Contact Sustainability for upcoming volunteer hours.

cards.title: Chapel Lawn
cards.subtitle: The lawn directly in front of Saint Mary’s Chapel
cards.notes: Bring a blanket for a quiet outdoor pause, then check the campus calendar for lawn-based community programs and scheduled events.
cards.short_summary: A prominent lawn outside the Chapel that also hosts College gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s identifies Chapel Lawn as the space in front of the Chapel and lists campus community events held there.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor availability can vary with College events and reservations; use posted guidance and respect any event setup.

cards.title: Cassin Student Union
cards.subtitle: Student-union destination on the campus map
cards.notes: Use the union as a central meeting landmark, and pair a stop there with the nearby Intercultural Center, Café Louis, and Ferroggiaro Quad.
cards.short_summary: A named student-union destination clustered with several student-facing campus spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s current campus map lists Cassin Student Union as a campus destination, and the College’s worship-spaces page identifies its fountain area.
cards.access_notes: Check campus signage and scheduling information for any room-specific access or event restrictions.

cards.title: Claeys Lounge in the Soda Activity Center
cards.subtitle: Soda Activity Center event and gathering space
cards.notes: Look for College programs using Claeys Lounge, then plan it as a clear indoor meeting point when attending a scheduled event or celebration.
cards.short_summary: A named Soda Activity Center lounge used for College programs and celebrations.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s 2026 Commencement schedule lists Claeys Lounge as the location for College graduate celebrations, and the current campus map lists it in the Soda Activity Center.
cards.access_notes: Use the College events calendar for public programs; room availability may be limited by scheduled functions.
